title: EntityIdentity — opaque, stable identity for any Pāṭala entity
description: Per newbuild1 §2: 'Entity identity is opaque and independent of content.' UUIDv7 with human prefix. Never encode title, source, date, version, or SHA into the identity.

id.description: UUIDv7 with prefix (PTW_, PTP_, PTED_, PTMS_, PTTR_, PTOBS_, PTEVT_)
